A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our p.F191 mutation is a novel disease-causing mutation, which causes a mild cranioface malformation and a complete-penetrance polydactyry with dominant-negative impairment on E2a-dependent transcription.

the TA domain of Twist1 is critical for the Twist1-E2A heterodimer-dependent transcription and the Twist1 function, which could provide a new insight for the SCS disease mechanisms.
